title: WordPress vs Webflow: Which Should You Build On?
h1: WordPress vs Webflow: which should you build on?
description: WordPress and Webflow compared for business websites: design control, content editing, plugins, hosting, maintenance and what each needs from a developer.
intro: WordPress and Webflow can both power a professional business site, but they work very differently. WordPress is open software with a huge ecosystem of themes and plugins that you host and maintain. Webflow is a hosted visual design tool that produces clean, custom layouts without a plugin stack. This article compares them so you can brief the right kind of freelancer.

faq.q: Which is better for a blog or content-heavy site?
faq.a: WordPress is very strong for large amounts of content and many authors. Webflow can handle blogs too, but WordPress has more built-in publishing tools.

faq.q: Which gives a more custom design?
faq.a: Webflow is designed for custom visual layouts. WordPress can match it with a good theme or custom development.
WordPress needs regular updates to the core, themes and plugins. Webflow handles hosting and platform updates for you.

faq.q: Can I edit the content myself later?
faq.a: Yes in both, if the developer sets up the editing area properly. Ask for a short walkthrough at handover.
It depends. WordPress software is free but hosting, themes, plugins and upkeep add up. Webflow charges for hosting and site plans. Compare the full yearly cost for your case.
